Manifest.Description: 中文：供货商与奥丁下一次开店优先到访，支持预约去重和冷却清除；提供交易与夜间调查预测、调查满值后的自动清除来电，并新增顾客需求／治安盘查递归高亮、放大镜自动鉴定及改造人检测理由。 English: Next-opening supplier and Odin visits, crime and investigation forecasts, automatic cleanup calls, recursive demand and inspection highlights, automatic appraisal estimates, and augmented-human detection with reasons.
